name: Beta RR 390

photo.credit: Beta Motor studio photograph (MY2027 RR Race 4T), used privately

rake.note: 2019 RR-S figure; Beta does not publish rake for the current chassis. The photo's fork line measures 26.3°.

calibration: Scale 0.847 px/mm is the mean of three photo measurements: front tyre 588 px against 90/90-21 (695 mm nominal), rear tyre 584 px against 140/80-18 (681 mm nominal), and axle spacing 1242 px against the 1480 mm wheelbase. They agree within 1.5%.

Footpeg (550, 446 mm) and the seat point (633, 1008 mm) are measured from the photo. Beta lists 950 mm seat height and 427 mm peg height. The photo is about 60 mm higher at the seat and 19 mm higher at the peg, which suggests the studio bike stands on extended suspension. Bar-to-bar differences are unaffected.

The fork cap sits 947 mm up the steering axis from the front axle. The top clamp is modelled 10 mm below that, with the bar centre 32 mm above the clamp and 12 mm ahead of the steering axis. These mount dimensions are estimates; use the riser and clamp sliders to match your own bike.
